scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @prepforge/server" "npm run dev -w @prepforge/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @prepforge/shared && npm run build -w @prepforge/server && npm run build -w @prepforge/client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @prepforge/server && npm run lint -w @prepforge/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @prepforge/shared && npx tsc --noEmit -p server/tsconfig.json && npx tsc --noEmit -p client/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run test -w @prepforge/server && npm run test -w @prepforge/client
scripts.db:types: npx supabase gen types typescript --local --schema public > packages/shared/src/database.generated.ts
